description: Short real-run smoke for 23_dino: pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. This is a ViT method (DINO's own ViT-S/16, no timm): both train.img_size (global crop) and train.local_size stay divisible by the patch size 16 (64 and 32), and train.n_local_crops is shrunk so the multi-crop forward stays small.
